O.outcome_detail: number and percentage of students classified as LTEL

result.effect: almost 380,000 to just over 226,500; 18% to about 11%

cells.quote: "between 2021–22 and 2022–23, the overall number of students classified as LTEL dropped from almost 380,000 (and 18% of all ever-ELs) to just over 226,500 students (and about 11% of all ever-ELs)."
cells.note: The Figure 2 trend sentence is not included in the supplied study text; quote reproduced from the wiki entry.

O.outcome_detail: initial English proficiency level on the English proficiency assessment

cells.quote: Substantial differences in the initial level of English acquisition. Sixty-four percent of students designated as LTEL7 started schooling at level 1 (the Beginner level) on the English proficiency assessment as compared to 40% of other ever-ELs.
cells.note: The study reports a descriptive comparison and no inferential test.

O.outcome_detail: 2022–23 CAASPP English language arts performance

cells.quote: Large performance gaps on the grades 6–8 and grade 11 CAASPP state tests in ELA and math, with students designated as LTEL7 performing at lower levels than other ever-ELs. In addition, some students designated as LTEL7 who reached the recommended academic achievement cut point on the CAASPP ELA test were not yet reclassified as fluent English proficient.
cells.note: The study reports an observational comparison, not a randomized treatment.

O.outcome_detail: proportion of ever-EL students designated as LTEL7

cells.quote: the proportion of students designated as LTEL7 was progressively smaller in every grade after 6th grade, from about 30% of ever-ELs in 7th grade to about 17% of ever-ELs in 12th grade. Between each grade level from 9 to 12, the proportion of students designated as LTEL7 among ever-EL students decreased by 2 percentage points.
cells.note: The study compares observed grade-level proportions in CALPADS enrollment data for 2022–23; no intervention or learning setting is described.

O.outcome_detail: future performance prediction across four real-world datasets and evaluation metrics

cells.quote: Finally, extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.
cells.note: The study text states that LT-MKT outperformed 11 baselines across four datasets and evaluation metrics, but the supplied text does not provide printed effect sizes or enough information to classify the benchmark comparison design.

O.outcome_detail: gains in students’ argumentative dialogue

cells.quote: In total, 72 studies (50%) reported that some type of coach-based method was effective in bringing out any type of gains in students'argumentative dialogue, and 77 studies (54%) did so with task-based methods (32 studies used both coach-based and task-based methods).
cells.note: The quoted sentence is from the wiki entry, not the supplied study text. This is a descriptive frequency from an integrative review, not a direct treatment-versus-comparison effect estimate.
